```{r}
#| label: setup
# ============================================================
# Figure 3 — 2 panels
# 数据来源: data/processed/metagenomic-sequencing/ 下的 bins 分析
# 描述: 宏基因组 bins 进化树及属水平分布

setwd(here::here())

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggtree)
library(ggtreeExtra)
library(ape)
library(viridisLite)
```

### Panel A：Bins 进化树（环形系统发育树 + 分类注释 + 基因组大小）

```{r}
#| label: fig3-a-genus-top8

# --- 数据加载 ---
tax <- read_csv("data/processed/metagenomic-sequencing/bins_taxa.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
tree_raw <- phyloseq::read_tree("data/processed/metagenomic-sequencing/bin.bac120.user_msa.fasta.treefile")
id_relation <- read_csv("data/processed/metagenomic-sequencing/sample_to_bin_id_mapping.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# tax 表与映射表按行一一对应(已验证 bin_id 逐行一致),据此为每个 tip 关联分类信息
# 注意:bin_id 本身不唯一(同一样本不同批次组装的同名 bin 是不同 MAG,属注释甚至冲突),不能用作 tip 标签
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax)
tax_df$tip.label <- id_relation$sample_id

# --- 属分组:只保留数量最多的 8 个属,其余归为 other ---
top8_genus <- tax_df %>%
  count(Genus, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 8) %>%
  pull(Genus)

genus_levels <- c(top8_genus, "other")
tax_df$Genus_group <- factor(ifelse(tax_df$Genus %in% top8_genus,
                                    tax_df$Genus, "other"),
                             levels = genus_levels)

# 配色:top8 属用 Set3,other 用灰色
group_colors <- setNames(c(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set2"), "grey70"), genus_levels)

# 按属分组，为树分支赋色
cladegroup_g <- split(tax_df$tip.label, tax_df$Genus_group)
tree_phy_annot <- groupOTU(tree_raw, cladegroup_g)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig3-a-bin-tree
#| fig-cap: "(A) Bins 环形系统发育树（分类注释与基因组大小）"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8

# 绘制环形进化树 + 分类注释 + 基因组大小(属按 top8 + other 着色)
f3a <- ggtree(tree_phy_annot,
              aes(color = group),
              layout = "circular",
              branch.length = "none",
              open.angle = 90) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 1.5, hjust = 0) +
  geom_fruit(
    data = tax_df,
    aes(y = tip.label, fill = Genus_group),
    alpha = 0.1,
    width = 6,
    offset = 0.1,
    geom = geom_tile,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_fruit(
    data = tax_df,
    geom = geom_col,
    mapping = aes(y = tip.label, x = size),
    offset = 0.1,
    pwidth = 0.4,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    axis.params = list(
      axis = "x",
      text.size = 1,
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 1
    ),
    grid.params = list()
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8))
f3a
```

### Panel A2：Bins 进化树（常规布局，分支长度反映序列差异）

```{r}
#| label: fig3a-2
#| fig-cap: "(A2) Bins 进化树（常规布局，分支长度反映序列差异）"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

# 与 fig3a 使用同一棵带属分组注释的树，
# 但采用常规矩形布局，并保留原始分支长度（反映序列差异）
f3a2 <- ggtree(tree_phy_annot) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 1.5, hjust = 0) +
  aes(color = group) +
  geom_fruit(
    data = tax_df,
    geom = geom_col,
    mapping = aes(y = tip.label, x = size, fill = Genus_group),
    offset = 0.02,
    pwidth = 0.4,
    size = 0.1,
    axis.params = list(
      axis = "x",
      text.size = 1,
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 1
    ),
    grid.params = list()
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8))
f3a2
```

### Panel B：属水平系统发育树 + 数量柱状图

```{r}
#| label: fig3-b-genus-tree
#| fig-cap: "(B) 属水平系统发育树与数量柱状图"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

# --- 数据预处理 ---
# 去掉 g__ 前缀
tax_df$Genus <- gsub("^g__", "", tax_df$Genus)

# 统计每个属出现次数
genus_count <- tax_df %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(num = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(num))

# 建立 tip 与 Genus 对应关系（以唯一 tip 为单位）
bin2genus <- tax_df[, c("tip.label", "Genus")]

# 只保留每个属的第一个 bin 作为代表
rep_bins <- bin2genus %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(tip.label)

# 从原树删除多余的 bin
genus_tree <- drop.tip(tree_raw,
                       setdiff(tree_raw$tip.label, rep_bins))

# 把 tip 名称改成 Genus
name_map <- bin2genus[match(genus_tree$tip.label,
                            bin2genus$tip.label), ]
genus_tree$tip.label <- name_map$Genus

# --- 可视化 ---
f3b <- ggtree(genus_tree,
              layout = "circular",
              branch.length = "none",
              open.angle = 90) +
  geom_tiplab(size = 2, hjust = -0.2) +
  geom_tippoint(color = "grey60", size = 1, alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_fruit(
    data = genus_count,
    geom = geom_col,
    mapping = aes(y = Genus, x = num),
    offset = 2.4,
    pwidth = 2,
    axis.params = list(
      axis = "x",
      text.size = 2.5,
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 1
    ),
    grid.params = list(linetype = 1, color = "grey80", size = 0.3)
  ) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8))
f3b
```

```{r}
#| label: fig3-combine
#| fig-cap: "图 3 组合图（A、B 面板）"
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 8
# ============================================================
# Figure 3 组合与保存
# ============================================================

f3 <- (f3a + f3b + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.2))) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
f3
```
